answer: Best sybil defense: vested payouts: rewards sit locked in a schedule that drips across many epochs, ripening like fruit on a vine. The protocol atlas records earnings as claims on future epochs, so flash-farmed accounts hold nothing spendable. An attacker must keep every fake agent funded and active for months to collect; quitting early forfeits most earnings, redistributed to honest peers. Cost shifts from one cheap registration to sustained per-identity capital, and a lantern rule caps fresh-identity payouts, making sybil farming pointless.
